package composite_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"

	client "example.com/composite/gen/TRANSPORT/composite/client"
	server "example.com/composite/gen/TRANSPORT/composite/server"
	svc "example.com/composite/gen/composite"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestCompositeAdditionalMembers(t *testing.T) {
	var calls atomic.Int32
	echo := func(_ context.Context, value any) (any, error) {
		calls.Add(1)
		return value, nil
	}
	mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
	server.Mount(mux, server.New(&svc.Endpoints{Objects: echo, Unions: echo, Nested: echo, Recursive: echo, Literal: echo, Nullable: echo, Mapped: echo, Occurrence: echo, Bytes: echo, ByteNested: echo, ByteNullable: echo, ByteOccurrences: echo}, mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, SERVER_OPTIONS))
	host := httptest.NewServer(mux)
	defer host.Close()
	c := client.NewClient("http", strings.TrimPrefix(host.URL, "http://"), host.Client(), loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, wire string
		payload    any
		call       func(context.Context, any) (any, error)
	}{
        {"bytes", `{"id":"record","x":"aGk="}`, new(svc.ByteRecord), c.Bytes()},
        {"byteOccurrences", `{"base":{"x":"aGk="},"record":{"x":"aGk=","more":"aGk="},"sibling":{"x":"aGk=","other":"aGk="}}`, new(svc.ByteOccurrences), c.ByteOccurrences()},
        {"byteNested", `{"x":[{"child":"aGk="}]}`, new(svc.ByteNested), c.ByteNested()},
        {"byteNullable", `{"x":null}`, new(svc.ByteNullable), c.ByteNullable()},
		{"objects", `{"x":{"name":"leaf"}}`, new(svc.Objects), c.Objects()},
		{"unions", `{"x":{"name":"leaf"},"y":{"count":2}}`, new(svc.Unions), c.Unions()},
		{"nested", `{"x":[{"y":{"name":"leaf"}}]}`, new(svc.Nested), c.Nested()},
		{"recursive", `{"name":"root","child":{"name":"leaf"}}`, new(svc.Recursive), c.Recursive()},
		{"literal", `{"a":42,"a:b":0,"a,b":1,"":2,"-":3,"quote\"slash\\":4,"line\nend":5,"日本語":6,"AdditionalAttributes":7,"foo":8,"Foo":9}`, new(svc.LiteralKeys), c.Literal()},
		{"nullable", `{"value":null}`, new(svc.NullableKeys), c.Nullable()},
		{"mapped", `{"a":1,"a:b":0}`, new(svc.MappedKeys), c.Mapped()},
		{"occurrence", `{"record":{"x":{"name":"base"},"more":{"name":"occurrence"}}}`, new(svc.OccurrenceKeys), c.Occurrence()},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(tc.wire), tc.payload))
			before := calls.Load()
			result, err := tc.call(t.Context(), tc.payload)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, before+1, calls.Load())
			require.Equal(t, tc.payload, result)
			output, err := json.Marshal(result, json.Deterministic(true))
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.JSONEq(t, tc.wire, string(output))
		})
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct{ name, wire string }{
        {"byteOccurrences", `{"base":{"x":"aGk="},"record":{"x":"aGk="},"sibling":{"x":"aGk=","other":"aGk="}}`},
        {"byteOccurrences", `{"base":{"x":"aGk="},"record":{"x":"aGk=","more":"aGk="},"sibling":{"x":"aGk="}}`},
        {"bytes", `{"x":"hi"}`},
        {"bytes", `{"x":"aA=="}`},
        {"bytes", `{}`},
        {"byteNested", `{"x":[{"child":"aA=="}]}`},
        {"byteNullable", `{}`},
		{"objects", `{}`},
		{"unions", `{}`},
		{"nested", `{}`},
		{"nullable", `{}`},
		{"mapped", `{"x":1}`},
		{"occurrence", `{"record":{"x":{"name":"base"}}}`},
		{"literal", `{"a":42,"a,b":1,"":2,"-":3,"quote\"slash\\":4,"line\nend":5,"日本語":6,"AdditionalAttributes":7,"foo":8,"Foo":9}`},
		{"objects", `{"x":{"name":""}}`},
		{"objects", `{"x":null}`},
		{"unions", `{"x":{"count":-1}}`},
		{"unions", `{"x":{"name":"leaf","count":1}}`},
		{"nested", `{"x":[{"y":{"name":""}}]}`},
	} {
		t.Run("reject "+tc.name+tc.wire, func(t *testing.T) {
			before := calls.Load()
			path, body := "/"+tc.name, tc.wire
			if IS_RPC {
				path = "/rpc"
				body = `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"` + tc.name + `","params":` + tc.wire + `}`
			}
			response, err := host.Client().Post(host.URL+path, "application/json", strings.NewReader(body))
			require.NoError(t, err)
			raw, err := io.ReadAll(response.Body)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.NoError(t, response.Body.Close())
			if IS_RPC {
				require.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, response.StatusCode)
				require.Contains(t, string(raw), `"code":-32602`)
			} else {
				require.Equal(t, http.StatusBadRequest, response.StatusCode, string(raw))
			}
			require.Equal(t, before, calls.Load())
		})
	}
}
